title: Shared value types
description: Building blocks referenced by the other schemas (contract section 4 and appendix D).

request_id.description: Opaque trace id, echoed back, decides nothing (section 4).

key_b64_32.description: Appendix D.2: standard base64 (with padding) of exactly 32 bytes.

context.description: Section 5.2: the only key-derivation context of v1.

health_state.description: States a running core can report through health (section 5.1); 'stopped' means the process is gone and nothing answers.

egress_confinement.description: Section 1.1: how far the operating system confines the core's own sockets.

extensions.description: Section 4 and I9: the one place a request may carry fields the receiver does not know; ignored, never security-relevant.
